question_ref: Q.50 (numbered Q.41 in some solution sets)
text: Let S be a set consisting of 10 elements. The number of tuples of the form (A, B) such that A and B are subsets of S, and A is a subset of B is ______.
solution: Decide independently for each of the 10 elements: in both A and B, only in B, or in neither. The fourth combination (in A but not in B) is forbidden by A subset of B. So the count is 3^10 = 59049.
